description: The Nonlinear model is the same as the Mohr-Coulomb Joint Model In 3DEC except that the normal and shear stiffness may depend on the normal stress as in the Continuously Yielding Joint Model In 3DEC . The tiffness behavior differs from the Continuously-Yielding Joint Model in that during unloading, the stiffness is constant and is equal to the stiffness at the point of unloading.

property_groups.name: Properties
property_groups.description: Joint properties for the 'nonlinear' joint constitutive model. Assign the model with 'block contact jmodel assign nonlinear [range ...]', then set these with 'block contact property <keyword> <value> [range jmodel nonlinear]'.

properties.description: maximum joint normal stiffness (STRESS/LENGTH). Defaults to k_n.
minimum joint normal stiffness (STRESS/LENGTH). Defaults to k_n.
current calculated joint normal stiffness (read only)
maximum joint shear stiffness (STRESS/LENGTH). Defaults to k_s.
minimum joint shear stiffness (STRESS/LENGTH). Defaults to k_s.
current calculated joint shear stiffness (read only)
residual friction angle (DEGREES). Defaults to phi.
shear displacement at which dilation stops (LENGTH). Default is infinity
Live-enumerated on 3DEC 9.7.47 (note the underscore naming, unlike every other hyphenated property); absent from the official 9.7 theory page. Semantics uncurated.

usage: block contact jmodel assign nonlinear ; block contact property <prop> <value> [range jmodel nonlinear]
